paths.title: Applied Scientist Interview Preparation
paths.summary: Follow the existing roadmap, then the numbered breadth notes from learning foundations through models, deep learning, evaluation and statistics. Each step opens the original canonical note.

steps.title: Orientation and Interview Roadmap
steps.summary: Start with the existing interview roadmap and topic checklist.

steps.title: 1. Fundamentals & Learning Paradigms
steps.summary: Compare learning paradigms, model families and inductive bias.

steps.title: 2. Bias-Variance Tradeoff & Regularization ⭐⭐⭐
steps.summary: Study bias, variance and regularization before comparing models.

steps.title: 3.1 Linear Models
steps.summary: Work through linear regression and classification models.

steps.title: 3.2 Tree-Based Models
steps.summary: Study decision trees and their ensemble extensions.

steps.title: 3.3 Support Vector Machines
steps.summary: Study margins, kernels and support vector machines.

steps.title: 4.1 Clustering
steps.summary: Compare clustering methods and probabilistic clustering.

steps.title: 4.2 Dimensionality Reduction
steps.summary: Study dimensionality-reduction methods and their tradeoffs.

steps.title: 5. Probabilistic Models
steps.summary: Study probabilistic graphical models and inference.

steps.title: 6.1 Neural Network Fundamentals
steps.summary: Review feedforward networks, activations and training fundamentals.

steps.title: 6.2 Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
steps.summary: Study convolutions, pooling and convolutional architectures.

steps.title: 6.3 Computer Vision
steps.summary: Continue to computer-vision tasks and object detection.

steps.title: 6.4 NLP Techniques
steps.summary: Review text representations and language-processing methods.

steps.title: 6.5 Sequential Models (RNNs, LSTMs)
steps.summary: Study recurrent networks, LSTMs and GRUs.

steps.title: 6.6.1 Attention Mechanisms
steps.summary: Study attention mechanisms before the transformer architecture.

steps.title: 6.6.2 Transformer Architecture
steps.summary: Continue from attention to transformer architecture.

steps.title: 7. Reinforcement Learning
steps.summary: Review reinforcement-learning concepts and algorithms.

steps.title: 8. Training & Optimization
steps.summary: Consolidate losses, optimizers and practical training techniques.

steps.title: 9. Model Evaluation & Validation
steps.summary: Study the roles of training, validation and test splits.

steps.title: 10. Evaluation Metrics
steps.summary: Choose and interpret model evaluation metrics.

steps.title: 11. Practical ML Challenges
steps.summary: Review missing data and other practical machine-learning challenges.

steps.title: 12. Statistics & Experimentation ⭐⭐
steps.summary: Finish with probability, statistical inference and experimentation.
